title: NIST AI RMF 1.0 to EN 18286:2026

useCase.intendedUsers: Lead auditors and reviewers who want to show where evidence gathered against one framework also bears on the other.
useCase.purpose: Show where EN 18286 audit evidence also bears on NIST AI RMF outcomes, and the reverse.
useCase.assumptions: Relationships compare what each requirement asks for, not how an organisation implements it. Each entry is single-source, so it can be read in both directions. No inference may be drawn from outcomes or requirements that are not mapped. Every entry is intersects_with: a NIST outcome and the other requirement only overlap, so a full result on one side is never shown as full on the other. The NIST side was read against NIST AI 100-1 Tables 1 to 4 (checked 2026-11-13). Draft until the EN 18286 framework is released (#57): its numbers are not yet confirmed against a licensed copy, and the titles on that side are our own. The EN 18286 clause structure itself comes from a secondary source, so every entry is low confidence.

entries.justification: Establishing the risk management process overlaps with establishing the quality management system and its scope.
Executive responsibility for AI risk decisions overlaps with the leadership clause.
Setting the level of risk management activity overlaps with planning the quality management system.
Measuring performance before deployment overlaps with the life-cycle realisation clause, which covers much more.
Post-deployment monitoring overlaps with the market and monitoring clause.
Periodic review of the risk process overlaps with management review.

notes: Clause-level overlaps only; the EN 18286 side is cited by clause number only (D-03). Not an official NIST crosswalk.
